remediation.name: qmoi_ai.deb
remediation.evidence: Local and GitHub v1.2.3 copy begin with invalid ar signature ('!<arch>P' instead of '!<arch>\n') and `ar` outputs 'file format not recognized'.
recommended_steps: Rebuild the .deb from source using the repo's packaging/build pipeline (preferred).
If this is an Electron app: run `npm install` and `npx electron-builder --linux deb` on a CI runner with Debian/Ubuntu environment so dpkg tools are present.
If building manually: create a proper deb structure (debian/control, debian/rules) and run `dpkg-deb --build <pkgdir>`; verify with `ar t` and `dpkg-deb -I`.
As an interim alternative, produce an AppImage and update the manifest/release to use it if target platforms allow.

After rebuilding: run `python3 scripts/verify_apps.py` to validate, update `release_assets_manifest.json` with size and sha256, then replace the GitHub release asset (requires repo PAT) or create a new release tag.
remediation.notes: Automatic restore from older releases returned the same corrupted bytes; therefore replacement is required.
